t: This is East London Cemetery, in Plaistow, which also has a crematorium. Several well-known people are buried here. Elizabeth Stride is believed to have been the third victim of Jack the Ripper. Lilian Baylis managed the Old Vic and Sadler's Wells, and her companies grew into the English National Opera and the Royal Ballet. Jack Warner is remembered as PC George Dixon in Dixon of Dock Green. Terence Spinks won Olympic gold in boxing in 1956. Carl Hans Lody, a German naval officer, spied in Britain in the first months of the First World War.
